description:
The shared calendar for friends, couples, and family

This is the app you’ve seen all over TikTok. 10M downloads, 200M+ plans made, and 1B+ views across social media. Howbout is how millions of people actually see each other more. 

Planning shouldn't take a hundred messages and a "when works for you?" thread that goes nowhere. Howbout fixes that. Find the gap, lock in the plan, actually see the people who matter to you.

…

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH HOWBOUT

SEE WHEN EVERYONE'S FREE
No guessing, it's right there on the calendar.

MAKE PLANS
Add events, add details, and keep everything together, so plans don't fall apart.

SHARE YOUR CALENDAR OR AVAILABILITY
Choose what people see. Stay private or share with friends.

KEEP ALL THE DETAILS IN ONE PLACE
Plans, chats, locations, notes, photos… no switching apps or losing the details.

REAL TIME NOTIFICATIONS
Get updates when plans change or when your friends are up to something fun.

MAKE YOUR CALENDAR YOURS
Color-code and customize your calendar how you like.

SYNC YOUR CALENDARS & TIMELINES
Work, school, personal, social… it's all in one place, so nothing clashes.

UP NEXT WIDGETS
Stay on top of your upcoming plans and see what your friends are up to from your home screen.

…

BUILT FOR REAL LIFE

For friend groups: check availability, lock in plans, actually see each other more.

For couples: stay in sync, plan dates faster, stop double-booking each other.

For families: track school runs, appointments, and weekends, all in one place.

…

HOWBOUT+

Unlock more customization like colors and app themes, smarter planning tools, and get an all around better experience.

Your subscription will automatically renew unless turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage your subscription in your App Store settings.

releaseNotes:
You know at the end of Grease when Sandy goes from being the cute girl-next-door to… hot? Well, we’ve gone and done it again. 

Howbout has officially had a complete glow-up!

We’ve completely refreshed the app with a brand new look, updated fonts, and a total overhaul of our theme, event, and friend colours. It’s cleaner, sleeker, and looking better than ever.

And because we know you love to keep your life in sync, we’ve got another massive update for you: you can now directly sync your Google Calendar to Howbout! No more switching back and forth between apps to see when you’re actually free.
